Google 授权未能完成，请检查客户端配置，并使用有本站访问权限的账号重新连接: Google authorization could not be completed. Check the client configuration and reconnect with an account that has access to this site.
暂时无法完成 Google 连接，请稍后重试；若持续失败，请检查客户端配置和网络: Google could not be connected right now. Try again later. If the problem persists, check the client configuration and network connection.
Google 搜索词需要 OAuth 只读授权，普通 API Key 无法读取: Google search terms require read-only OAuth authorization. A regular API key cannot access Search Console data.
先在 Google Cloud 启用 Search Console API，创建: Enable the Search Console API in Google Cloud, create a Web application OAuth client, and add the callback URL below. Save the configuration, connect Google, then select the property for this site.
查看 Google 官方接入说明: Read the official Google setup guide
在 Bing Webmaster Tools 中获取 API Key，使用本站在: Get an API key from Bing Webmaster Tools and enter the full URL verified for this site. The key field is cleared after saving; stored keys are never displayed.
加载失败，请重试: Could not load. Please try again.
连接 Google Search Console 后可读取真实搜索词；也可以先导: Connect Google Search Console to load actual search terms, or import a CSV first.
填写 Bing Webmaster API Key 后可读取搜索词；也可以先导入: Enter a Bing Webmaster API key to load search terms, or import a CSV first.
授权已失效或没有该资源的访问权限，请检查接入设置。: Authorization has expired or does not allow access to this property. Check the integration settings.
Google 已授权，请选择并保存本站对应的 Search Console 资源: Google is authorized. Select and save the Search Console property for this site.
搜索平台响应超时，请稍后重试。: The search platform timed out. Please try again later.
搜索平台暂时无法读取，请稍后重试。: Search platform data is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
当前范围暂无关键词。最近的数据可能延迟，部分低频查询不会公开。: No keywords are available for this range. Recent data may be delayed, and some rare queries are withheld.
太平洋时间，整站搜索表现；最多前 50 个词。数据可能延迟，低频查询可能被隐藏。: Site-wide search performance in Pacific Time, with up to 50 top terms. Data may be delayed, and rare queries may be withheld.
Bing 返回的可用数据，按周更新，无法按日期筛选；记录日期不等于完整覆盖范围。: Available Bing data, updated weekly without date filtering. Record dates do not define the full period covered.
每份 CSV 独立展示，日期来自导入时的填写。缺失指标显示 —，不当作 0。: Each CSV is shown separately using the dates entered during import. Missing metrics appear as —, not as zero.
还没有导入报告，可在下方上传搜索平台导出的 CSV。: No imported reports yet. Upload a CSV exported from your search platform below.
从搜索平台导出按关键词汇总的 UTF-8 CSV，选择报告对应的日期。每次导入独: Export a UTF-8 CSV aggregated by keyword from your search platform and select its report dates. Each import is kept separately without replacing history or combining overlapping periods. Limit: 1 MB and 5,000 rows.
CSV 文件不能超过 1 MB: The CSV file must be no larger than 1 MB.
无法读取 CSV 文件: Could not read the CSV file.
导入成功，已切换到这份报告。: Import complete. This report is now selected.
操作失败，请重试: The action failed. Please try again.
根据真实关键词寻找改进方向，建议需人工核实。不会自动修改网站，也不会还原隐藏的搜: Find opportunities using actual keyword data. Suggestions need human review. This does not automatically change your site or recover hidden search terms.
填写兼容 Chat Completions 的服务。密钥加密保存，仅站点管理员可: Configure a service compatible with Chat Completions. Keys are stored encrypted and managed only by site administrators. The provider may charge for requests.
服务商提供的模型名称: Model name supplied by your provider
留空保留已保存的密钥: Leave blank to keep the saved key
默认选第一项；服务商要求旧版参数时再切换。: Use the first option by default. Switch only if your provider requires the older parameter.
密钥和模型配置已移除，历史建议仍保留。: The key and model configuration were removed. Previous suggestions are retained.
点击生成后，将站点域名和当前报告中展现量最高的最多 50 个关键词及指标发送给你: Generating suggestions sends the site domain and up to 50 keywords with the most impressions in the current report, along with their metrics, to your configured model service. Visitor records are not sent.
建议已生成，请结合实际页面核实。: Suggestions generated. Review them against your actual pages.
先选择一份有数据的报告，再生成建议。: Select a report containing data before generating suggestions.
当前没有可分析的真实关键词数据，请先连接搜索平台并选择有数据的范围。: There is no actual keyword data to analyze. Connect a search platform and select a range containing data.
请先填写模型接口、模型名称和 API Key。: Enter the model endpoint, model name, and API key first.
模型配置无法读取，请重新保存接口和 API Key。: The model configuration could not be read. Save the endpoint and API key again.
更换模型接口时必须重新填写 API Key，避免将旧密钥发送到其他接口。: Enter the API key again when changing the model endpoint to avoid sending the old key to another endpoint.
模型接口须为公网标准 HTTPS 地址，且以 /chat/completions: The model endpoint must be a public HTTPS URL on the standard port, ending in /chat/completions.
模型服务拒绝授权，请检查 API Key 和模型权限。: The model service denied authorization. Check the API key and model permissions.
模型服务限流或额度不足，请稍后重试并检查服务商额度。: The model service is rate limited or out of quota. Check your provider quota and try again later.
模型请求超过 45 秒，请稍后重试。: The model request exceeded 45 seconds. Please try again later.
模型服务连接失败或返回错误，请检查接口和模型名称后重试。: The model service could not be reached or returned an error. Check the endpoint and model name, then try again.
模型未返回有效建议，或引用了数据中不存在的关键词，请重试。: The model returned invalid suggestions or referenced keywords absent from the data. Please try again.
本站已有建议正在生成，请等待完成。: Suggestions are already being generated for this site. Wait for them to finish.
每个站点一分钟内只能生成一次，请稍后重试。: Each site can generate suggestions once per minute. Please try again later.
建议配置或历史暂时无法保存，请稍后重试。: Suggestion settings or history could not be saved right now. Please try again later.
站点不存在或没有管理权限: The site does not exist or you do not have permission to manage it.
导入记录不存在或不属于此站点: The imported report does not exist or does not belong to this site.
关键词读取失败，请先连接搜索平台并确认报表可用: Could not load keywords. Connect the search platform and confirm that its report is available first.
Google Search Console 整站，太平洋时间，按点击量返回的前: Site-wide Google Search Console data in Pacific Time: the top 50 terms returned by clicks, excluding queries withheld by the platform.
Bing 接口可用关键词，按周更新，不能按所选日期筛选；记录日期不代表精确覆盖范: Keywords available from the Bing API, updated weekly without filtering by the selected dates. Record dates do not define the exact period covered.
请选择有效的导出日期范围，结束日期不能早于开始日期: Select a valid export date range. The end date cannot precede the start date.
CSV 编码无效，请使用 UTF-8 编码重新导出: Invalid CSV encoding. Export the file again using UTF-8.
CSV 文件没有关键词数据: The CSV file contains no keyword data.
部分 AI 配置或历史无法读取。关键词报告仍可使用；配置异常时请重新填写接口和密: Some AI settings or history could not be loaded. Keyword reports remain available. If the configuration is invalid, enter the endpoint and key again.
当前有其他站点正在生成建议，请稍后重试。: Other sites are currently generating suggestions. Please try again shortly.
模型设置有未保存的修改，请先保存再生成建议。: Model settings have unsaved changes. Save them before generating suggestions.
部分历史建议无法解密，已保留原记录；当前显示可读取的建议。: Some past suggestions cannot be decrypted. The original records are preserved; readable suggestions are shown.
太平洋时间，所选资源的搜索表现；最多前 50 个词。数据可能延迟，低频查询可能被: Search performance for the selected property, using Pacific Time. Up to the top 50 terms; data may be delayed and rare queries may be hidden.
Bing 返回所选资源的可用数据，按周更新，无法按日期筛选；记录日期不等于完整覆: Available Bing data for the selected property, updated weekly. Date filtering is unavailable; record dates do not imply full coverage.
Google 所选资源的搜索点击量，按所选日期与太平洋时间汇总，不跟随访客筛选。: Google search clicks for the selected property and dates in Pacific Time, independent of visitor filters. Up to the top 50 terms; some rare queries are withheld.
Bing 所选资源的搜索点击量，显示接口可用数据，按周更新，不跟随上方日期或访客: Bing search clicks for the selected property, using available weekly data independently of dashboard date and visitor filters. Up to the top 50 terms.
模型服务配置已在其他页面更改，请刷新并确认当前服务后重新生成。: Model service settings changed in another page. Refresh and confirm the current service before generating again.
搜索平台密钥无法读取，请重新保存配置或重新授权: The search platform credentials cannot be read. Save the configuration again or reconnect.
请选择本站域名或 www 别名对应的搜索平台资源: Select a search property matching this site’s domain or www alias.
请填写有效的 Bing API Key: Enter a valid Bing API Key.
当前 Google 账号没有该资源的访问权限，请重新连接并选择可用资源: The current Google account cannot access this property. Reconnect and select an available property.
暂时无法核实 Google 资源，请重新连接或稍后重试: The Google property could not be verified. Reconnect or try again later.
Google OAuth 配置无法读取，请重新填写客户端信息和密钥。: The Google OAuth configuration cannot be read. Enter the client details and secret again.
新增或更换 Google Client ID 时，请填写对应的 Client S: Enter the matching Client Secret when adding or changing a Google Client ID.
已切换，当前浏览器无法保存显示方式。: Layout changed. This browser cannot save your preference.
地图样式已保存，统计页将使用此样式。: Map style saved. Statistics pages will use this style.
样式已保存，请刷新页面载入最新设置。: Style saved. Refresh to load the latest settings.
选择后自动保存到当前账号。标准为默认地图并适配界面深浅色；街道和深色保持自身配色: Your choice is saved to your account. Standard is the default and follows light/dark mode; Streets and Dark keep their own colors. Previews show the same area.
更换服务或地址后，请重新填写密钥。: Enter the keys again after changing the provider or endpoint.
已保存。留空保留，填写新值可替换。: Saved. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a new value to replace it.
填写此存储桶对应的 API 密钥。: Enter the API key for this bucket.
连接 Cloudflare R2 或 Amazon S3，存放站点、账号和访问记: Connect Cloudflare R2 or Amazon S3 to store backups of sites, accounts and visit records.
填写已创建的桶名称，不含路径。: Enter an existing bucket name without a path.
在 R2 存储桶概览中复制 S3 API 地址；不要填写公开访问域名。: Copy the S3 API endpoint from the R2 bucket overview; do not use a public access domain.
标准 Amazon S3 可留空；使用自定义地址时请填写完整的 HTTPS 地址: Leave blank for standard Amazon S3, or enter a complete custom HTTPS endpoint.
R2 使用 auto，系统自动选择区域。: R2 uses auto to select the region automatically.
填写存储桶所在的 AWS 区域，例如 us-east-1。: Enter the bucket’s AWS region, such as us-east-1.
备份存放在此前缀下，留空使用 litestats。: Backups are stored under this prefix. Leave blank to use litestats.
密钥加密保存在服务器，保存后不再显示原文。: Keys are encrypted on the server and are not shown again after saving.
连接测试失败，请重试: Connection test failed. Please try again.
测试当前填写的信息，不会保存设置或创建备份。: Tests the current values without saving settings or creating a backup.
连接成功，可以读取备份目录: Connected. The backup folder can be listed.
已验证 {0} 的读取权限，未上传或删除文件。: Verified listing access to {0}. No files were uploaded or deleted.
上传权限将在执行备份时验证。: Upload permission will be checked when a backup runs.
备份包含 PostgreSQL 站点与账号数据，以及 ClickHouse 访问: Backups include PostgreSQL site and account data, and ClickHouse visit events.
距离上次成功备份满一小时后执行，后台每分钟检查一次。: Runs one hour after the last successful backup. The server checks once per minute.
选择“仅手动”可关闭自动备份。: Choose Manual only to turn off automatic backups.
使用已保存的存储配置，立即备份或查找已有备份。: Use the saved storage settings to run a backup or find existing backups.
请先保存修改，再执行备份、扫描或恢复。连接测试可以直接使用当前填写的信息。: Save changes before backing up, scanning or restoring. Connection testing uses the current values.
这个目录下还没有 LiteStats 备份: No LiteStats backups in this folder yet
扫描后，这里会列出可恢复的备份。: Scan to list backups available for recovery here.
恢复会覆盖当前数据库。请确认备份后再操作。: Restoring overwrites the current database. Verify the backup before continuing.
Region 只能包含小写字母、数字和连字符: Region may contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens
前缀不能包含控制字符: The prefix must not contain control characters
Access Key 不能包含空白或控制字符: Access Key must not contain whitespace or control characters
Secret Key 不能包含空白或控制字符: Secret Key must not contain whitespace or control characters
请填写有效的 HTTPS R2 S3 API Endpoint: Enter a valid HTTPS R2 S3 API endpoint
请填写有效的公网 HTTPS S3 Endpoint，不能包含凭据、查询参数或片: Enter a public HTTPS S3 endpoint without credentials, query parameters or a fragment
存储服务或 Endpoint 已更改，请重新填写 Access Key 和 Se: The storage provider or endpoint has changed. Enter Access Key and Secret Key again.
请填写 R2 S3 API Endpoint: Enter the R2 S3 API endpoint
请填写 S3 Region，例如 us-east-1: Enter an S3 region, such as us-east-1
请填写存储桶、Access Key 和 Secret Key: Enter the bucket, Access Key and Secret Key
连接测试超时，请检查 Endpoint 或稍后重试: Connection test timed out. Check the endpoint or try again later.
认证或列出对象权限失败，请检查密钥和存储桶的读取权限: Authentication or object listing failed. Check the keys and bucket listing permission.
未找到存储桶，请检查存储桶名称和 Endpoint: Bucket not found. Check the bucket name and endpoint.
存储桶区域不匹配，请检查 Region 和 Endpoint: The bucket region does not match. Check the region and endpoint.
无法解析存储地址，请检查 Endpoint: The storage address could not be resolved. Check the endpoint.
存储地址的 HTTPS 证书验证失败: The storage endpoint’s HTTPS certificate could not be verified
无法连接对象存储，请检查 Endpoint、Region、存储桶和权限后重试: Could not connect to object storage. Check the endpoint, region, bucket and permissions, then try again.
上次备份失败，请检查存储配置和权限后重试: The last backup failed. Check the storage settings and permissions, then try again.
请先填写存储桶和密钥: Enter the bucket and keys first
悬停或轻触查看详情，空白表示没有检查记录: Hover or tap for details. Gaps indicate no recorded checks.
